summary: The weighted distance dual is exact and both primal and dual optima are attained. Coordinatewise primal-dual equality gives the stated saturation, support contacts, and load bounds. The load-minimal stress admits the claimed conformal extreme-ray decomposition, with strict negativity forced by load minimality. Both contact measures satisfy the asserted halfspace domination, including the stronger one-half factor under the endpoint bounds. The endpoint collapse, selector-capacity bound, asymptotic residual-rank conclusion, and the explicit sharpness family all follow with the stated constants and boundary cases.
